Darwin's Cat: the licence of these impulse responses

The impulse responses in this archive (every .wav, and the .toml beside it) are made by
Darwin's Cat and licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence
(CC BY 4.0).

In plain words: you may use, share and change them for any purpose (in music, in programs,
in devices, in commercial and closed products too) as long as you credit Darwin's Cat, for
example

  IR: Darwin's Cat, darwinscat.com

name the licence, and say if you changed them. They come as they are, with no warranty.

The licence in full: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode
